query:
SELECT mn.id, mn.magicNumber, mn.name, mn.password, mn.usdtAddress, mn.usdtNetwork, COUNT(p.id) as payment_count 
FROM magic_numbers mn 
LEFT JOIN payments p ON mn.id = p.magicNumberId 
WHERE mn.password IS NOT NULL 
GROUP BY mn.id 
ORDER BY payment_count DESC 
LIMIT 5;
